svg.metadata: {"collision_pairs": [], "height_inches": 10.0, "labels": [{"rendered": "训练保存完整答案；推理停在 assistant 标记之后", "role": "text", "source": "训练保存完整答案；推理停在 assistant 标记之后"}, {"rendered": "回到无合并的主算例：user=256，assistant=257，EOS=258。下方生成选择只是说明协议。", "role": "text", "source": "回到无合并的主算例：user=256，assistant=257，EOS=258。下方生成选择只是说明协议。"}, {"rendered": "训练序列", "role": "text", "source": "训练序列"}, {"rendered": "[256,97,258,257,98,258]", "role": "text", "source": "[256,97,258,257,98,258]"}, {"rendered": "含用户 a、助手 b 与结束标记；正文和结束标记在模型调用前已知。", "role": "text", "source": "含用户 a、助手 b 与结束标记；正文和结束标记在模型调用前已知。"}, {"rendered": "推理前缀", "role": "text", "source": "推理前缀"}, {"rendered": "[256,97,258,257]", "role": "text", "source": "[256,97,258,257]"}, {"rendered": "format_chat([user]) 后，只追加 assistant 角色 ID；此时不加助手 EOS。", "role": "text", "source": "format_chat([user]) 后，只追加 assistant 角色 ID；此时不加助手 EOS。"}, {"rendered": "接回 07.04", "role": "text", "source": "接回 07.04"}, {"rendered": "prefill · shape [1,4]", "role": "text", "source": "prefill · shape [1,4]"}, {"rendered": "select 98 = b", "role": "text", "source": "select 98 = b"}, {"rendered": "送入内容 [[98]]", "role": "text", "source": "送入内容 [[98]]"}, {"rendered": "select 258 → stop", "role": "text", "source": "select 258 → stop"}, {"rendered": "prompt 中的用户 EOS 不会提前停；07.04 检查的是新选出的 ID。格式化本身不训练权重。", "role": "text", "source": "prompt 中的用户 EOS 不会提前停；07.04 检查的是新选出的 ID。格式化本身不训练权重。"}], "language": "zh-CN", "math_engine": "XeLaTeX with unicode-math", "minimum_print_font_pt": 9.5, "name": "08-01-inference-prefix.zh-CN", "numeric_data_sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855", "outside_labels": [], "rendered_fonts": ["STSongti-SC-Bold", "STSongti-SC-Regular", "TimesNewRomanPS-BoldMT", "TimesNewRomanPSMT"], "typography_sha256": "41d401d817f6d65a7cda1fc30c8c4be889e4d32284b5078fcf5e5e51af2166d5", "vector_pdf_sha256": "65c0cf57a057e8c5bd63b79faa69ca8ff45cc6031d41d054a2be43981d3ba49a", "width_inches": 14.0}
